055-words.text: Your films: SCION 055 Words — Polysemic Relay (folder `055-words`; the prompt proposes the word 'draw', but choose the word whose senses the archive can actually show visibly — forage several candidate words such as draw / run / turn / spring / press / pitch / break / light and pick the strongest; document the choice) and SCION 057 Moments — Microevent Attention (folder `057-moments`).

057-moments.text: Your films: SCION 055 Words — Polysemic Relay (folder `055-words`; …) and SCION 057 Moments — Microevent Attention (folder `057-moments`). Both films were given to one agent in one assignment.

056-symmetry.text: Your films: SCION 056 Symmetry — Imperfect Pairing (folder `056-symmetry`, split-screen pairs using the renderer's layer boxes, plus the sequential-cut alternative the prompt asks for as edl-alt.json), SCION 060 Losers, SCION 065 Five. One agent made all three films.

060-losers.text: SCION 060 Losers — Social Position Through Montage (folder `060-losers`; the prompt wants staged performers; from archive footage you may only use a sequence in which the social relations exist WITHIN one source recording — e.g. a classroom, playground, dance, or social-guidance film; make the tight-opening cut and the wide-opening comparison cut; if no single source carries the relations honestly, make the smallest honest version and say so).

065-five.text: SCION 065 Five — Parallel Lives, Unequal Details (folder `065-five`; five people/places from different archive sources doing a small practice; no inferred religious identity; each gets an uninterrupted action).

058-laughs.text: Your films: SCION 058 Laughs! — Audible Contagion (folder `058-laughs`; you need clips WITH sound where people are visibly laughing; check the audio itself, e.g. extract and analyse waveform/onsets, and the frames; if the archive has few real laughs, make a shorter honest chain or end on room tone as the prompt allows; make the voices-only cut and, only if it adds a relation, a music variant) and SCION 063 Breath — Invisible Force, Visible Consequence (folder `063-breath`; breath, steam, smoke, wind, fans, bellows, candles blown, condensation — keep human breath and mechanical air distinguishable).

063-breath.text: SCION 063 Breath — Invisible Force, Visible Consequence (folder `063-breath`; breath, steam, smoke, wind, fans, bellows, candles blown, condensation — keep human breath and mechanical air distinguishable). Given in one assignment together with 058 Laughs.

061-matter.text: Your films: SCION 061 Matter — Material Affordance Chain (folder `061-matter`; pressure, folding, wetting, pouring, molten, kneading, cutting — material transformations visible within shots), SCION 062 Colors, SCION 064 Parabolas. One agent made all three films.

062-colors.text: SCION 062 Colors — Chromatic Chapters (folder `062-colors`; use the index's hue/sat/palette to forage colour shots, then verify by eye; three chapters, no recolouring).

064-parabolas.text: SCION 064 Parabolas (etc.) — Curves With Different Causes (folder `064-parabolas`; hanging cables/chains, thrown/jumping/fountain trajectories, arches; for the fitted-guide replay you may track a moving object with OpenCV and draw a fitted curve overlay as a separately rendered layer — write a small script that burns the guide onto copies of the frames, keep it clearly a model overlay, and include a version with the guides removed).

059-ball.text: Not delegated. This film was made directly by the session lead, after the shared tools were built. Method: the archive's text search cannot find a shape, so scan every still and clip frame for circles (Hough, scored by rim-edge support), read the top candidates by eye, measure each anchor, register by translation and uniform scale only, add an unregistered control, compose a tap score with one beat omitted at the contextual release.
